description: Registry of C-Box norm profiles. Each entry points to a SHACL shapes file that binds to a dhc:Norm instance in the T-Box, and to the dhc:NormEdition that file implements. Scoped to France while the v3 core is prototyped — DIN VDE 0100 (DE), AREI/RGIE (BE) and BS 7671 (GB) were removed in v3.0.0 and are re-added once dhc-core is released. Every profile listed here must bind to a dhc:Norm and a dhc:NormEdition that exist in the T-Box, and the T-Box's dhc:shapesFile must agree with the file named here; tests/cbox/manifest.test.js enforces all three.
editionNote: One profile per EDITION, not per norm (changed in 3.1.0). Compliance is computed by validating against each edition's shapes and comparing the verdicts: passing the latest is green, passing an older one but failing the latest is grandfathered. That is impossible with a single profile per norm. The T-Box's dhc:shapesFile on each dhc:NormEdition is authoritative; this manifest mirrors it so downstream apps can enumerate profiles without parsing Turtle.
deltaNote: A profile with "delta": true carries ONLY what its edition adds or tightens, and is meaningless on its own. Its effective rule set is itself concatenated with every profile down the dhc:supersedes chain. Concatenation ANDs constraints, so an edition may add or tighten but NEVER loosen — see the header of nfc15100-2024.shapes.ttl.
